mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku_supplier_rel SET sku_id = #{skuId}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, purchase_price = #{purchasePrice}, delivery_cycle_day = #{deliveryCycleDay}, min_order_qty = #{minOrderQty}, supplier_sku_code = #{supplierSkuCode}, default_flag = #{defaultFlag}, enable_status = #{enableStatus}, remark = #{remark}, modify_id = #{modifyId}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE corpid = #{corpid} AND id = #{id} AND del = 0
